criteria_1_auth_before_side_effects.details: All 7 route handlers call requireMarketingSession() as the first statement and return 401 before any DB access or AI call. Tests assert db.select/db.insert/db.update are NOT called on the 401 path.

criteria_2_positive_controls.details: Every guard has a positive-control test: settings-auth (GET→200, POST→200), video-auth (5 routes all→200), campaigns-auth (4 routes all→200). Each asserts validateSession was called with the known token. A blanket-401 regression would fail all positive controls.

criteria_3_zod_validation.details: 5 new Zod schemas reject malformed bodies. 14 input-validation tests verify 400 responses before any persistence/AI side effect. Schemas use z.object() default .strip() behavior and z.record() for settings.

criteria_4_secret_masking.details: GET /api/settings returns '••••' for secret-shaped keys (matching /apiKey/i, /secret/i, /token/i). The route never imports decrypt(). Tests assert plaintext and ciphertext do not appear in response body for both unauthenticated (401) and authenticated (200) paths.

criteria_5_ai_adapter.details: generate-script and research-topics routes import createAIClient from '@/lib/ai' which re-exports from '@reading-advantage/ai'. Static guard scans all app/api/*.ts for direct provider SDK imports — count is 0. Behavioral tests confirm createAIClient is called with the stored API key.

criteria_6_phase3_test_updates.details: Existing tests updated with authedRequest() helper. Assertions strengthened: GET secrets test now expects masked '••••' instead of decrypted plaintext; tampered ciphertext test now expects 200 with masked placeholder instead of 500 (route no longer decrypts); empty body test now expects 400 instead of 200 (Zod rejects empty). All changes are stronger, not weaker.

criteria_7_file_parallelism.details: vitest.config.ts adds fileParallelism:false to prevent mock-factory race isolation. Justified and committed.

criteria_8_plan_markers.details: 4 of 6 Phase 2 tasks correctly marked [x] with commit hashes. 2 tasks remain [~] but ARE complete (evidence in phase-w3-*.test.ts committed at 81d104e2). Plan markers should be updated to [x] — documentation hygiene, not a correctness blocker.

criteria_9_business_logic_separation.details: Auth guard in app/lib/auth.ts, Zod schemas in app/lib/*-schema.ts, secret redaction in app/lib/redact.ts, masking in settings route. Route handlers are thin orchestration: guard → validate → persist/query.
